snippet.title: Maskborne - Official Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST ON STEAM - https://store.steampowered.com/app/4366780/Maskborne/

Support us to help fund console release and multiple languages:
https://www.patreon.com/c/Maskborne

We're getting comments faster than we can reply, so we've created an FAQ to answer the most common questions: 

👁1. What is Maskborne?
Inspired by Ori, Hollow Knight, and Ghibli, Maskborne is a hand-drawn Metroidvania set in a world where death has disappeared. Fight twisted creatures, uncover forgotten secrets, and discover powerful Boundlings as you journey to restore death to a world that has forgotten how to die. 

🎮 2.⁠ ⁠What platforms will the game be on?
Steam on PC first. If we sell enough copies, the game will be made available everywhere.

📱3.⁠ ⁠Will it be on mobile (Android/iOS)?
We’re looking into it to see if this is possible. We’re not sure if a game like Maskborne will be satisfying to play on a mobile device so research and testing is needed. 

🗣4.⁠ ⁠What languages will you support?
We’re hoping to make the game available in as many languages as possible, including Portuguese, Spanish, French, German, Polish, Korean, Japanese, Chinese, Arabic, and Russian.

🗓5.⁠ ⁠When is the release date?
Release date is TBA. We’re still early in development and expect another 3-4 years until launch.

👀6.⁠ ⁠Will there be a demo?
We’re building a playable vertical slice we hope to wrap up in April. This will be a closed demo for a small group of playtesters. A full public demo will be available at a later date. 

💵7.⁠ ⁠How much will it cost?
No set price yet. This will come later once we have a better idea of the length and how much content we can deliver.

🎵8.⁠ ⁠Who is doing the music? 
The OST is made by the incredibly talented Johannes Johansson who also did the music for the game HOA. He is known as Akmigone on YouTube. The OST will be available for purchase on Steam.

⏳9.⁠ ⁠How long is the game?
We’re aiming for 15-25 hours. However, we'd rather go shorter and deliver a tailored experience than pad it out with filler to hit a bigger number.

🔥10.⁠ ⁠How difficult is the game?
The game will be challenging, but not as difficult as Silksong for example. There will be boss fights, gauntlets, and challenging platforming sections, but there will be no corpse running and no long runbacks. We also want to focus heavily on exploration and strange encounters with the inhabitants of the world, so there needs to be a good balance between the more intense moments of the game and the melancholic, and at times lonely journey through the world.

🦑11.⁠ ⁠What are Boundlings?
Boundlings and ingredients will be a big part of what makes Maskborne unique. As you explore the world, you will collect strange ingredients you can either eat for a quick buff, feed to NPCs, or combine into little Pokemon type creatures that grant you unique abilities - we call these Boundlings. You can mix and match your Boundlings to create unique builds and gameplay experiences, and will even be able to evolve and upgrade them for enhanced effects. However, you can only carry a limited amount of Boundlings, so you will have to think strategically about your build. 

🎣12.⁠ ⁠Will there be fishing?
Yes. It’s a must.

📜13.⁠ ⁠Will there be lore?
Yes, lots of it. We’re big on deep lore, mystery, forgotten secrets and all the things that makes a world feel ancient and lived in. 

✨14.⁠ ⁠How big is the team?
We’re 2 people (husband and wife), and our composer Johannes.

Join our Discord to stay up to date with the game.
https://discord.gg/MeEAAtH5eb

Music By Johannes Johansson aka @akmigone 

DEV X - https://x.com/mjthehunter
ARTIST X - https://x.com/Emilie_Stabell
OFFICIAL X - https://x.com/maskbornegame
